text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with<n>Rice Shower...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: U-umm... do you see the claw<n>machine over there?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She points toward a claw machine<n>filled with
Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there are plushies of all<n>my friends in
there. I'm a little<n>curious...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's trying to show restraint, but<n>she has an
obvious twinkle in her<n>eye.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
My bad luck might rub off on you...<n>But I'll cheer
you on!
